decision.explanation: Documents d00, d01, and d02 consistently state Edmund Ralph Brockman was born on 22 October 1828, while documents d03 and d04 contain a conflicting date of 15 July 1835 that contradicts the earlier arrival in the Swan River Colony in January 1830 mentioned in the same texts; the 1828 date is further supported by the Australian Dictionary of Biography reference in d01.
